samplingInterval.description: The sampling interval, in seconds, of the downstream content sharing data.

startTime.description: The date and time when this content sharing session started.

endTime.description: The date and time when this content sharing session ended.

packetLoss.description: The percentage of content sharing packet loss, as a float between 0.0 and 100.0, during each sampling interval.

latency.description: The average latency, in milliseconds, during each sampling interval.

resolutionHeight.description: The height in pixels of the incoming share video.

frameRate.description: The frame rate of the incoming share video.

mediaBitRate.description: The bit rate for the incoming share video.

codec.description: The codec for the incoming share video.

jitter.description: The jitter for the incoming share video.

transportType.description: The network protocol used for video transmission.
